name: rusty-procgen
description: Deterministic dungeon generation, validation, and inspection workbench for Rusty Engine consumers.

scripts.batch:sample: pnpm run procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10
scripts.geometry:recovery: cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path procgen-rs/Cargo.toml --bin rusty-procgen -- batch generate --profile fixtures/batch-profiles/v2-sample.json --out-dir artifacts/samples/batch-v2 --seed 5201 --count 10 && pnpm run geometry:recovery:report
scripts.viewer:serve:regenerate: pnpm run baseline && pnpm run batch:sample && pnpm run build:viewer && node scripts/serve-viewer.mjs
scripts.viewer:smoke: pnpm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/smoke-rusty-renderer-inspection.mjs && node scripts/smoke-viewer.mjs
scripts.policy:smoke: pnpm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && node scripts/smoke-placement-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-geometry-policy-experiment.mjs && node scripts/smoke-corridor-realization-experiment.mjs
scripts.ca:fixtures: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path procgen-rs/Cargo.toml --example generate_ca_fixtures -- fixtures/ca/scenarios.v1.json fixtures/ca/delta-traces.v1.json
scripts.ca:fixtures:check: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path procgen-rs/Cargo.toml --example generate_ca_fixtures -- --check fixtures/ca/scenarios.v1.json fixtures/ca/delta-traces.v1.json
scripts.test: pnpm run check:migration-boundary && pnpm run check:corpus-identity && pnpm run engine:revision && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run engine:publication:test && pnpm run engine:spatial:test && pnpm run rust:test
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:migration-boundary && pnpm run check:corpus-identity && pnpm run engine:revision && pnpm run ca:fixtures:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run engine:publication:test && pnpm run engine:publication:clippy && pnpm run publish:rusty-engine-smoke && pnpm run engine:spatial:test && pnpm run engine:spatial:clippy && pnpm run voxel:rusty-engine-smoke && pnpm run build:viewer && node scripts/smoke-voxel-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/smoke-generation-config.mjs && pnpm run rust:check && pnpm run rust:test
